name: 3dentes
description: Interactive 3D atlas of human oral anatomy, in the browser.

scripts.test: node tools/version.test.mjs && node tools/ontology.test.mjs && node tools/bundle.test.mjs && node tools/tooth-morphology.test.mjs
scripts.test:enamel: node -e "const{STRUCTURES,toothNotation}=require('./tools/manifest.mjs');const o={};for(const s of STRUCTURES){const n=toothNotation(s);if(n)o[n.universal]=s.type;}require('fs').writeFileSync('/tmp/3dentes-tooth-types.json',JSON.stringify(o));" && python3 tools/cbct/enamel_test.py /tmp/3dentes-tooth-types.json
